about_the_game:
A semester lasts 30 days. Every day brings choices—attend club meetings, wander the city, or share quiet moments after class. As the Witch, you’re tasked with stealing hearts to survive… but what if the hearts you steal change your own?

Each character has their own story arc:

  • Caramel Clementine, the elegant fashion leader hiding her insecurities behind a smile.

  • Leon Chay, the energetic athlete who hides his dark past.

  • Ares Easton, the brooding writer who finds light in your presence.

  • Lemon Poppyseed, the playful trickster who wants you all to themselves.

  • Lime Poppyseed, the disciplined council president who slowly reveals vulnerability.

  • Noah Archbach, the quiet gardener who learns how to make meaning out of life with you.

  • Sarah Lin, the bookworm whose sharp wit conceals her fragile hope.

Your decisions unlock new events, CG illustrations, and branching confession scenes. Will you remain the Witch who steals hearts, and deal with the consequences?

  • 30-day semester structure — time-limited choices affect affection, events, and endings.

  • Seven romanceable characters — each with unique routes, CGs, and confession moments.

  • Branching dialogue system — every choice nudges affection and unlocks hidden scenes.

  • CG illustrations — special moments captured as collectible memories.

  • Atmospheric soundtrack — cozy cafés, quiet libraries, and rooftop nights under the stars.

  • Multiple endings — who will you choose when the semester ends?

name: Heart Stealer
short_description: Step into the shoes of a witch disguised as a student for one semester. In this heart-stealing visual novel RPG, build relationships with seven unique characters and decide whose heart you’ll claim… or who might just steal yours.
